_purpose: The Generator appends the matching set to each post by content type. Anchor tags go on EVERY post. Keep total tags per post around 8-15 (quality over stuffing). The Analyst's top_hashtags feedback in brand-voice.json can promote winners over time.

usage_rules.every_post: 3 anchor tags + the matching set (8 tags) = 11 total. Good baseline.
usage_rules.october: Add 2-3 from october_additions, trim a couple of the weaker set tags to stay ~13-15.
usage_rules.rotation: Don't post the identical tag block every single time — Instagram can dampen reach for repetitive blocks. Vary 2-3 tags per post within the set's theme.
usage_rules.placement: First comment OR end of caption — pick one and stay consistent.

_meta.note: Generator reads anchor_tags + sets[post_type]. Small addition to generator.js prompt/assembly step — flagged in CONFIG_README.md.
